description.value: The Best Western Plus Fernie Mountain Lodge is a full-service hotel situated in the heart of Fernie, British Columbia, with views of the Canadian Rockies. Fernie is a well-known destination for mountain biking and cycle touring, making this lodge a convenient base for exploring the surrounding trails and routes. The property offers standard hotel amenities including complimentary breakfast and in-room kitchenettes in select rooms.

The property page amenity icons include 'free-breakfast' and 'free-high-speed-internet', which are authoritative signals from the hotel's own listing page, confirming Wi-Fi. No cycling-specific amenities (bike storage, tools, e-bike charging, bike wash) are mentioned anywhere in the fetched content, so all bike-related fields are null. A name discrepancy exists: OSM omits 'Plus' but the website consistently uses 'Best Western Plus Fernie Mountain Lodge'.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM records 'Best Western Fernie Mountain Lodge' but the hotel's own website consistently uses 'Best Western Plus Fernie Mountain Lodge' — the 'Plus' tier designation is missing from OSM.
Direct hotel phone number was not displayed in the fetched website content (only central reservations numbers shown), so the OSM phone number could not be confirmed.
